questions.question: What is God's opening call in Zechariah 1?
options: 'Return to me, and I will return to you'
'Flee the city, for it cannot be saved'
'Fear not, for the enemy has been destroyed'
questions.answer: 'Return to me, and I will return to you'

questions.question: What did Zechariah see in his first night vision?
options: A wide valley filled with very dry and scattered dead bones
A great and towering statue of gold and of silver and of clay
A man riding a red horse among the myrtle trees, with other horses
Four great and terrible beasts rising up out of the great raging sea
questions.answer: A man riding a red horse among the myrtle trees, with other horses

questions.question: Zechariah 1 says the LORD is exceedingly jealous for Jerusalem and Zion.
Return to me, says the LORD of hosts, and I will _____ to you.
Zechariah saw a man riding on a red horse standing among the _____ trees.
